verdict.rationale: Attio's own reporting page lists a 'Weighted pipeline' report alongside stage conversion and win-rate metrics, and its reporting engine charts live deal data. That points to native weighting of pipeline value, but the evidence is only marketing labels with no documentation of how weighting works. Missing for 10: configurable per-stage probabilities, close-date-based revenue forecasting over time periods, in-depth first-party docs on the forecasting method, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forecast revenue from pipeline value, stage probabilities, and close dates
